content: {"reasoning":"The required authorization was missing, the 30-day retroauthorization window is closed, and Meridian offers no peer-to-peer review. A medical-necessity appeal has already been attempted, while resubmission or another appeal would not cure the authorization denial; the denial does not establish a contractual patient liability despite remaining deductible and coinsurance. With no collectible payer, secondary, or patient balance, the remaining amount should be written off.","action":"write_off"}
